notes.text: Andon's page announces the North American Type 1 Championships at AndCon '98 (October 1-4, 1998, Toledo): open, DCI sanctioned, Swiss with a final 8 single elimination, over $1000 in prizes and a trophy. The day of the event and the date of the final are not known; the date here is the last day of the convention and is not verified.

That it was played is confirmed only by Doug Equils, who wrote on 6 Oct 1998 that he had 'just returned from the type I Nationals where I was undefeated going into the final 8' (9-2 the previous day). He does not give his finish, so he is not listed.
No winner, Top 8 names, attendance or lists were found (Andon pages, The Duelist #24 and #30, the Dojo 1998 report index, web search). The decks list is empty.
